BullMQ

The fastest, most reliable, Redis-based distributed queue for Node.js, Python, Elixir, .NET, Rust, PHP, and more. Carefully written for rock solid stability and atomicity.

Documentation

You can find tutorials and news in this blog: https://blog.taskforce.sh/. The documentation covers the full API surface, including producers, workers, queues, schedules, and the proxying layer that lets other languages share the same Redis infrastructure.

Sponsors

Dragonfly is a new Redis drop-in replacement that is fully compatible with BullMQ and brings some important advantages over Redis, such as massive better performance by utilizing all CPU cores available on your machine.
